issue.title: subprocess_runner detached-grandchild pipe-drain tests intermittently miss the truncation flag under full just check
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-kj.3 (note #2) and triaged by the bob-cli-kj land agent. Not
caused by bob-cli-kj: the tests come from closed epic bob-cli-kf (commit 7b3f3512,
bead bob-cli-kf.5, "fix(subprocess): bound pipe draining and harden notify sleeps").

## What fails

Two sibling unit tests in `src/native/subprocess_runner.rs` (`-p bob-obsidian --lib`)
fail together, intermittently, under a full `just check`:

- `native::subprocess_runner::tests::run_bounds_pipe_drain_when_detached_grandchild_holds_output`:
  `output.stderr` lacks "output truncated".
- `native::subprocess_runner::tests::raw_run_bounds_pipe_drain_when_detached_grandchild_holds_output`:
  `output.output_incomplete` is false.

Both run `sh -c 'setsid sleep 8 & echo $!; exit 0'` and expect the inherited stdout
pipe to stay open past `PIPE_DRAIN_GRACE` (2 s), so the runner reports incomplete
output. When they fail, the drain apparently saw EOF within the grace period, as if
the detached `sleep 8` never held the pipe or exited early.

## Observations

- bob-cli-kj.3 phase (2026-11-11): `just check` lib target 6645 passed / 2 failed
  (these two), exit 101. The same two passed on clean HEAD in isolation (2.01 s).
- bob-cli-kf.land (2026-11-11): recorded the same pair as a transient drain flake that
  passed on rerun and on its final full run.
- bob-cli-kj.land (2026-11-11, master 3ba40fc5): full `just check` passed both.

That is roughly 2 failures in 4 or more full-suite runs, with none seen serially or in
isolation.

## Where to look

The root cause is not confirmed. Candidates: whether `setsid` forks (and the parent
exits) before `sleep` inherits the fd under load; another parallel lib test that kills
process groups or reaps children (`kill -KILL`, `waitpid(-1)`) and so ends the
detached sleep; and the timeout path versus the normal-exit path in `run`/`run_raw`
(lines ~105-145 and ~175-215). Make the tests deterministic without weakening the
bounded-drain contract. For example, have the fixture hold the pipe open
with a sentinel the test controls rather than racing a detached `sleep`.

task_type_fields.evidence: Failed 1/1 in bob-cli-kj.3's full just check (6645 passed, 2 failed: both drain tests), transient in bob-cli-kf.land (passed on rerun), passed in bob-cli-kj.land's full just check at 3ba40fc5 and in isolation (2.01 s). Parallel-suite only; never seen serially.
